name: The Gate Warden
lore: A stone-armoured giant bound to the castle gate. Its power, once taken, lets the bearer leap.
look: A towering knight in rust-streaked plate under a flat-topped great helm, two embers burning in the eye slit; a long torn cape and a two-handed maul.

avatar.note: assets/character/bosses/warden.glb, rigged onto the kit's bone names (actors/bosses/10b-warden-avatar.js). scale is the size in the world (the hero is about 1.8 m); weapon is a gear id from content/character/gear.json.
